card.name: Just before 'transdermal system' or patch
card.fires_on: The end of 'transdermal' (the 'mal' ending) or the word right before it, such as 'estradiol' or 'the', when a skin patch is being discussed. It fires in patch labels like Neupro, estradiol and clonidine.

modes.label: End of transdermal
modes.description: The final piece of the word 'transdermal' as it is spelled out, just before 'system', 'patch' or 'therapy'.
modes.example: hypersensitivity to rotigotine or the components of the transder<<mal>> system.

modes.label: Just before transdermal
modes.description: The last piece of 'estradiol', or the word 'the', right before 'transdermal' in patch instructions.
modes.example: in a woman switching from another estradi<<ol>> transdermal therapy.

card.writes: It adds dosage-form and preparation words such as 'dosage', 'preparation' and the Chinese word for 'agent', and it suppresses words for tablet, drop and spray.
card.plain: It lights up on skin-patch wording, at the end of the word transdermal or just before it.
